hero: Monitoring coral reefs concerns every diver. Underwater 3D imaging is now free and accessible, presenting an opportunity to participate in the conservation of the ocean. This guide explains how to scan a single coral colony over time and share the 3D models in an open-access database, enabling the development of AI tools for coral conservation.
cap: 3D imaging using smartphones enables to view single zooids in coral colonies from different genera: Image shows colonies from the genera Colpophyllia (top row), Montastrea (middle row), and Agaricia (bottom row).
